summary: This Form 6-K filed by Transportadora de Gas del Sur S.A. (an Argentine natural gas transmission company) on June 12, 2026, reports a credit rating upgrade by S&P Global Ratings from B- to B, triggered by a revision of Argentina's transfer and convertibility risk assessment. The filing is a routine material fact disclosure of a credit rating change, not a special situation such as a merger, acquisition, activist campaign, restructuring, or other transformative event. No deal terms, prices, or shareholder actions are involved. This is a standard current report by a foreign issuer, thus not classifiable as a special situation.
